clips.title: The story
paras: Tasked by Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Horde adventurers delve into the flooded temple of Blackfathom Deeps to recover a fathom core. The Earthen Ring seeks this relic to uncover the dark elemental plots of the invading Twilight's Hammer cult.

The ancient night elven temple of Blackfathom Deeps, once sacred to Elune, has fallen under the dominion of sinister forces. Deep within its submerged passages, the cultists of the Twilight's Hammer have established a stronghold. Stationed at the windswept shore of Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale, the Darkspear shaman Je'neu Sancrea observes the growing taint with rising alarm, recognizing that the cult intends to subjugate the local elements against the land and its defenders.

To counter the cult's designs, Je'neu tasks Horde champions with securing a fathom core from the underwater fathom stone within the Moonshrine Ruins. When correctly deciphered by skilled shamans, the core reveals an exhaustive chronicle of elemental currents and disturbances. With this artifact in hand, the Earthen Ring hopes to pierce the veil of the Twilight's Hammer's operations and shield the region from elemental catastrophe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us. If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

Friend, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water. In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity. If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been successful in locating the Fathom Core? Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is exactly what I need! A Fathom Core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from. Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.
You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us. You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
